description:
Paykut is a scalable platform that helps local businesses build a digital presence, manage customer interactions, and drive engagement.

It features dynamic merchant pages, real-time notifications, and a hybrid backend using Firebase (fast reads) and Express (business logic). The system is optimized for performance with caching, modular APIs, and Cloudinary-based image handling.

title: iChat
imageSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1360" height="606" viewBox="0 0 1360 606" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">

description:
Engineered a scalable full-stack real-time chat and social interaction platform using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js). Implemented secure authentication and authorization systems, enabling users to sign up, log in, manage profiles, and connect seamlessly with other users.

Built dynamic one-to-one and group messaging functionality with real-time communication capabilities, allowing users to create groups, exchange messages instantly, and maintain active conversations. Enhanced user engagement through interactive social features including post creation, likes, and comment systems.

Designed a responsive and intuitive frontend with React.js while developing robust RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js and Express.js. Integrated MongoDB for efficient data storage and management, ensuring optimized performance and scalability across the application.

This project highlights expertise in full-stack web development, real-time communication architecture, scalable backend systems, and building modern user-centric social platforms.

title: Streamify: AI-Powered CCTV NVR System
imageSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1865" height="963" viewBox="0 0 1865 963" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
  <image href="data:image/png;base64," width="1865" height="963"/>
</svg>
description: Engineered a full-stack Network Video Recorder (NVR) platform that transforms standard CCTV RTSP streams into an intelligent surveillance system. The backend orchestration seamlessly integrates FFmpeg for live HLS streaming and efficient segment recording, while a dedicated Python microservice processes frames in real-time. Leveraged MobileNet-SSD for live people counting density telemetry and dlib/face_recognition to identify and log known faces against a local SQLite database. Built a sleek, responsive Next.js dashboard featuring Server-Sent Events (SSE) for instantaneous overlay alerts, real-time analytics charts, and a tabbed historical logs viewer. Containerized the entire microservices architecture using Docker for simplified deployment and environment consistency.

title: System Architect — Cyberpunk Linux Live Wallpaper & Telemetry Daemon
imageSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1920" height="917" viewBox="0 0 1920 917" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
  <image href="data:image/png;base64," width="1920" height="917"/>
</svg>
description:
Designed and developed a performance-optimized system telemetry daemon and live wallpaper client wrapper for Linux environments, achieving sub-1.5% CPU overhead.
Implemented direct kernel filesystem query logic (/proc, /sys/class/hwmon) using Python to poll CPU, RAM, disk, temperature, network, and battery status asynchronously.
Architected a real-time WebSocket telemetry stream in FastAPI to broadcast active system, process-level statistics, Git workspaces, and Docker statuses at 1Hz to a client dashboard.
Built a dynamic React & TypeScript dashboard featuring automated 3D web rendering, interactive network mesh topologies, theme configuration, and rolling system journal logs.
Integrated the UI natively as a GNOME desktop wallpaper using PyWebView and GTK3, configuring X11 EWMH properties (_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_DESKTOP) to enable click-through functionality and prevent taskbar/Alt-Tab visibility.
Created automated shell-based install and management daemons setting up Systemd user services, virtual environments, local host name binding, and asset compilation.

title: Bonafide Social Group — Hybrid Serverless CMS & Web Portal
imageSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1912" height="928" viewBox="0 0 1912 928" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
  <image href="data:image/png;base64," width="1912" height="928"/>
</svg>
description:
Architected a Hybrid Static + Dynamic Serverless CMS using Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, achieving 99+ Lighthouse Performance and SEO scores by pre-rendering public pages statically while routing admin actions to secure serverless endpoints.
Designed a Many-to-Many Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) security system in PostgreSQL/Supabase, safeguarding management routes and REST API endpoints using dynamic session JWT checks and custom auth database schemas.
Engineered a client-side chunked batch-processing engine integrated with the Resend API to dispatch mass newsletter broadcasts in parallel batches of 100, preventing serverless execution timeout limitations and ensuring 100% email delivery tracking.
Developed a responsive visual media library and Bento Grid layout builder, incorporating canvas-based client-side image compression to convert uploads to optimized WebP format, reducing Supabase Storage costs and improving asset load times.
Implemented secure administrative password self-service and verification flows, featuring a custom 6-digit email recovery engine and interactive hide/reveal toggles utilizing Material icons.
Built a Git-backed content synchronization pipeline that automatically commits verified JSON schema modifications to GitHub on publish, triggering Vercel webhooks to rebuild and deploy the edge-cached frontend.
